title: Microwave-Promoted Total Synthesis of Puniceloid D for Modulating the Liver X Receptor.
authors: Jung, Young Jin; Hosseininasab, Narges; Park, Jungjin; Hyun, Soonsil; Jung, Jae-Kyung; Kwak, Jae-Hwan
one_liner_zh: 该文为天然产物Puniceloid D的全合成及与核受体LXR的分子对接研究，对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: A growing global health concern is metabolic syndrome, which is defined by low HDL, diabetes, hypertension, and abdominal obesity. Nuclear receptors are attractive targets for treatment of diseases associated with metabolic syndrome. Liver X receptors (LXRs) have become one of the most significant pharmacological targets among nuclear receptors. Multiple research studies emphasize the essential function of the liver X receptor (LXR) in the pathophysiology of metabolic syndrome. Puniceloid D, among natural products, demonstrated promising effects on LXRalpha. However, attempts at the total synthesis of natural products were faced with challenges, including long synthetic steps and low yields, requiring a more efficient approach. In this study, for the first time, we successfully synthesized puniceloid D through a seven-step process and conducted docking studies to gain a comprehensive understanding of the interactions involved in the binding of puniceloid D to LXR within different heterodimeric contexts. Our understanding of the pathophysiology of metabolic syndrome could be improved by these findings, which might assist with the development of novel treatment strategies.
abstract_zh: 日益严峻的全球健康问题是代谢综合征，其定义特征包括低高密度脂蛋白、糖尿病、高血压和腹部肥胖。核受体是治疗与代谢综合征相关疾病的有吸引力的靶点。肝X受体（LXRs）已成为核受体中最具重要药理作用的靶点之一。多项研究强调肝X受体（LXR）在代谢综合征病理生理学中的关键作用。在天然产物中，Puniceloid D对LXRalpha显示出有前景的效果。然而，天然产物的全合成尝试面临挑战，包括合成步骤长和产率低，需要更高效的方法。在本研究中，我们首次通过七步过程成功合成了Puniceloid D，并进行了对接研究，以全面理解Puniceloid D在不同异二聚体背景下与LXR结合所涉及的相互作用。这些发现可能改善我们对代谢综合征病理生理学的理解，并可能有助于开发新的治疗策略。
